x1 = sfilter(x0, hline): keep frontiers that are horizontal lines. A frontier frozenset that is a horizontal line has width == len(patch) and height==1. For a constant row, the frozenset is {(v,(i,0)),...,(v,(i,w-1))}, height 1, width w, len = w, so hline true. For a constant column, height = h, len = h, width=1, so hline false (unless h==1). So x1 = horizontal frontier rows.

x2 = size(x1) number of constant rows. x3 = positive.

If there is at least one constant row: x4 = tophalf, x5 = bottomhalf. Otherwise x4=lefthalf, x5=righthalf.

Input has 9 rows. Row index 4 is [4,4,4,4] — constant. So x1 nonempty, x3 true. So x4 = tophalf(I) = I[:4] (first 4 rows), x5 = bottomhalf(I) = I[9//2 + 1:] = I[5:] = rows 5..8 (4 rows).
